names: Sun Yat Sen Nanyang Memorial Hall
mapIdentity.scope: OpenStreetMap building way 271791487 gives 23 distinct perimeter controls. The full building belongs to the named memorial hall enclosure, way 271791474 (Q10123616). Its narrow central join identifies the break between original villa and connected rear museum extension.

note: The National Heritage Board documents a two-floor tropical villa with an open, curved porte-cochère and upper sitting room, Corinthian columns, cast iron railings, ornate arched openings, storey cornices, louvre shutters and filigree eaves. Its historical account identifies the later rear extension. Official trail text identifies overlapping orange-brown roof tiles.
